card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle of a split word, most strongly the 'ios' in 'anhydramnios' and 'oligohydramnios' in newborn and pregnancy terms. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated words, such as 'activity' or 'novels' after 'my' or 'our'.

modes.label: Nouns after 'my' or 'our'
modes.description: A noun that follows a possessive in general prose about creative work.
